clinic.name: Pacific Dental & Implant Solutions
clinic.heroSubtitle: As an ADA-recognized specialist practice, we provide comprehensive full-mouth restoration using advanced 3D imaging and 17+ years of expertise in dental implants and complex prosthetics.

differentiators.title: ADA-Recognized Specialist
differentiators.description: Dr. Jmi Asam is a specialist in Prosthodontics, a branch focused on rebuilding what general dentistry often leaves untouched.

differentiators.title: Implant-Focused Precision
differentiators.description: With 17+ years of experience, the practice specializes in full-arch reconstruction and complex restorative care for severe bone loss.

differentiators.title: Continuity Of Care
differentiators.description: The same doctor who diagnoses your case is the one placing the implant and following up, eliminating clinical handoffs.

differentiators.title: Patient-First Philosophy
differentiators.description: A local, independent practice that prioritizes honest treatment plans over high-pressure sales or profitable upsells.

treatmentJourney.title: Prosthodontic Consultation & 3D Scan
treatmentJourney.description: Your journey begins with a comprehensive exam and a free 3D CT scan to analyze bone density and map out a precise treatment plan.

treatmentJourney.title: Digital Treatment Planning
treatmentJourney.description: Dr. Asam creates a customized plan using 3D imaging to determine the ideal placement of implants and the design of your new teeth.

treatmentJourney.title: Specialized Foundation Work
treatmentJourney.description: The foundation phase includes any necessary extractions or bone augmentation, though many patients qualify for implants without grafting.

treatmentJourney.title: Precision Implant Placement
treatmentJourney.description: Using guided surgery techniques, implants are strategically placed into the jawbone to provide a permanent, stable foundation.

treatmentJourney.title: Provisional Restoration
treatmentJourney.description: Temporary restorations are often placed same-day to test bite alignment, aesthetics, and function while the implants integrate.

treatmentJourney.title: Final Permanent Delivery
treatmentJourney.description: Custom-crafted lab restorations are delivered, providing a beautiful, long-term solution that restores your smile and quality of life.

benefits.title: Specialist Expertise
benefits.description: Receive care from a Harvard-trained prosthodontist specializing in complex full-mouth reconstruction cases that general dentists often refer out.

benefits.title: Complimentary 3D Imaging
benefits.description: Every implant consultation includes a free 3D CT scan to ensure precise planning and the highest standard of surgical safety.

benefits.title: Efficient Restoration
benefits.description: Restore your confidence in just one visit with advanced tooth restoration services and All-on-4 immediate function techniques.

benefits.title: Honest Evaluation
benefits.description: Experience a clinical philosophy grounded in honest reviews of all options, ensuring you receive the right treatment for your unique needs.

benefits.title: Advanced 3D Technology
benefits.description: We utilize Cone Beam 3D imaging on every implant case to analyze bone density and determine the precise placement for long-term success.

benefits.title: Independent Care
benefits.description: Benefit from a doctor-owned practice where you work with the same specialist from your first consultation through your final restoration.

implantOptions.title: All-on-Four Full Arch
implantOptions.description: Receive a complete smile transformation in as little as one day with strategically placed implants that secure a full arch of new teeth.

implantOptions.title: Implant-Supported Crowns
implantOptions.description: Replace missing teeth at the root with lifelike porcelain restorations that preserve bone structure and function like natural teeth.

implantOptions.title: Complex Bridge Work
implantOptions.description: Meticulously crafted bridges that fill gaps, restoring proper bite alignment and facial balance for patients with multiple missing teeth.

implantOptions.title: Bite & TMJ Rehabilitation
implantOptions.description: Specialized prosthodontic care to address grinding damage and severe dental wear, restoring both function and aesthetics to your entire mouth.

faqItems.question: Why do I need a prosthodontist for full mouth restoration?
faqItems.answer: As an ADA-recognized specialist, Dr. Asam has three additional years of training beyond dental school to handle the most complex restorative and implant cases.

faqItems.question: How long does a full mouth reconstruction take?
faqItems.answer: While many transformations can happen in one visit with All-on-4, complex rehabilitations are phased to ensure proper healing and perfect bite alignment.

faqItems.question: Will I be without teeth during my treatment?
faqItems.answer: No. Dr. Asam offers immediate-function solutions like All-on-4 and temporary restorations so you can smile and eat throughout your journey.

faqItems.question: What factors affect the cost of dental implants?
faqItems.answer: Costs are based on your specific needs, including materials, necessary diagnostics, and whether additional bone grafting is required to support the implant.

faqItems.question: Can I get implants if I was told I have low bone density?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Using 3D CT imaging, Dr. Asam can often find solutions for patients previously told they weren't candidates, sometimes without bone graft surgery.

faqItems.question: Do you offer consultations for new patients?
faqItems.answer: Yes, we offer a free consultation and a complimentary 3D CT scan to help you understand your dental condition and find a solution that fits.

doctor.name: Jmi Asam
doctor.bio: Dr. Jmi Lilinoe Bassett Asam is a Harvard-trained, ADA-recognized Prosthodontist with over 17 years of experience in complex full-mouth reconstruction. After graduating summa cum laude from Creighton University and cum laude from Harvard School of Dental Medicine, she completed a three-year specialty residency in Advanced Prosthodontics. As the founder of Pacific Dental & Implant Solutions, she specializes in taking on the cases other dentists turn away, including severe bone loss and failed previous work. Dr. Asam personally manages every case to ensure clinical precision and lasting results.
